title: feat(console,app-shell): a settings action row draws its label once, on the button; the Installed Apps kernel note is the Uninstall tooltip (objectui#12610)
body:
Fixes #12610
Clause-②: yes

Items 1 and 4 of the card, as triage narrowed them. Items 2 and 3 are objectstack-ai/objectstack#23839 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#23841, not touched here.

## What changes

**1. A settings action row has one label, on the button.** The console's settings renderer drew an `action_button` specifier's `label` twice: as the row label on the left and again inside the button. That is why Mail Delivery read "Send test email / Send test email" and AI & Embedder repeated "Test connection", "Reset to environment defaults" and "Test embedder". The manifests declare one `label` each, so the fix is in the renderer, once, for every action row (`SettingsField`, the `action_button` branch).
- The button carries the label.
- The row's left side holds the specifier's `description` when the manifest declares one, as one line of muted text. Otherwise it holds nothing and the button stands alone at the row's end.
- No manifest declares a `description` on an `action_button` today, and the renderer invents none.
- Settings keys, values and save behaviour do not change. `SettingsView` is untouched.

**4. The Installed Apps kernel note is the Uninstall tooltip.** The "kernel API is additive only" paragraph sat at the foot of the list, including under the empty state. It now opens as a tooltip, on hover or focus, on a loaded local row's Uninstall. It is that button's accessible description (`aria-describedby` to one `sr-only` copy), using the console's existing `TooltipProvider` / `Tooltip` / `TooltipTrigger` pattern.
- A not-loaded row's Uninstall carries no note: that package left nothing in the running kernel (objectui#11645).
- A cloud-bound list offers no Uninstall, so it carries no note either.
- The note renders as text. The widget no longer passes it through `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.

**i18n.** `marketplace.installedAdditiveNote` dropped its leading bold "Note:" label (a `strong` element, and each translation's equivalent) in all ten packs. The sentence after it is unchanged, and so is the key name. `check:i18n-drift` reads one en value changed, followed by all nine packs.

## Tests

- `SettingsField.actionRowOneLabel-12610.test.tsx` (console). It renders the real `SettingsView` over a stubbed `fetch` for every `action_button` the server's settings manifests declare: Mail, SMS, AI × 3, Knowledge, File Storage. It asserts that no string a button carries is drawn anywhere outside that button. Also covered:
  - a label translated through `actions.ID.label`;
  - a declared description, shown once on the left;
  - no description, so nothing beside the button.
- `InstalledListWidget.kernelNoteTooltip-12610.test.tsx` (app-shell), in `en` and `zh`, over the real `marketplaceApi`:
  - the empty state carries no note;
  - a loaded Uninstall has the note as its accessible description, and hovering opens a tooltip with it and no markup;
  - a not-loaded Uninstall has no description;
  - all ten packs' values carry no markup.
- Ablation, after committing the fix, each leg trap-restored and checked on disk:
  - restoring the old label div: 8 failed (8);
  - restoring the old paragraph and dropping the tooltip: 6 failed | 11 passed (17);
  - restoring the bold label in `de`: 1 failed | 16 passed (17).

## Local gates (head `514ee9d`)

- Closure build of `@object-ui/console^...`: 34/34 tasks.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`: 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/ packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/ packages/i18n/`: 134 files passed, 1689 tests passed, 13 skipped.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols` and changeset presence: all 0.
- eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.
- The rest of the farm is CI's.

## Screenshots

Branch `claude/issue-12610-evidence`, under `evidence/12610/`. These are Mail Delivery, AI & Embedder (three action rows), File Storage and Installed Apps (empty state). They were taken at 1280 × 900 with the console dev server, against a published `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.1 showcase backend (`e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`). Each page has a `-before` shot (base `8ed7e5a`) and an `-after` shot (this head).

NOT MEASURED: a screenshot of the Uninstall tooltip itself. Reason: the fresh backend had no installed package, so there was no Uninstall row to hover. The tooltip is pinned by the app-shell test above.

## Changesets

- `12610-settings-action-row-one-label.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch.
- `12610-installed-apps-kernel-note-tooltip.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.
- `12610-i18n-kernel-note-plain-text.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` patch, carrying the Clause-② note.

## Acceptance notes

- Booting the live backend took two workarounds in a throwaway copy only:
  - npm 11 instead of npm 10, which crashed on `edgesOut`;
  - removing `isDefault` from the showcase `capability-map` page.
- The settings pages also needed `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai`. Without it, the seeded admin is refused `manage_platform_settings`.
- `e2e/live/ci/stop-backend.sh` left the `objectstack dev` child running on its port, so the next start came up on the next port. This is reported to the seat; it is not changed here.

Provenance: written by the `os-dev` cloud session `session_01P1jMq7XJa8LG1or2Z2jgxH` (claim `6211778237`) and opened by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`) from that session's final message, because a cloud session cannot open a PR from its container. The seat changed only the two tag-shaped spellings of the bold label into words.
